facts.fact: The overview states that Proclamation No. 1321/2024, Ethiopia's first comprehensive personal data protection law, was approved on 4 April 2024 and published in the Federal Negarit Gazette on 24 July 2024; it gives no commencement date.
The overview states that the proclamation designates the Ethiopian Communications Authority as the regulator; it does not say the Authority is acting under the law.
